groups.operation: Dump a JSON value through do_dump.
groups.capability: do_dump returns failure at the depth limit.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three describe the same depth guard in do_dump. Their differences concern how a value might reach the guard, not the target behavior.

groups.operation: Produce an indented string with json_dumps.
groups.condition: A nonzero indentation value is supplied in the dump flags.
groups.capability: json_dumps receives the JSON_MAX_INDENT bits and applies them through dump_indent.
groups.consequence: Clearing those bits prevents the requested indented string output.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three describe the same indentation flag mask on the json_dumps string path.

groups.condition: The output callback rejects a write.
groups.capability: json_dump_callback propagates the failure returned through do_dump.
groups.equivalence_reason: This callback rejection behavior has a different trigger and required capability from depth rejection and indentation.
